name: WhoPays
shadowNote: pixel-recessed — split-flap faces are inset (--seam), not floating; panels lift once (--el-2).
signatureElement: The split-flap seat card — three honest states (owing / paid ✓ / evicted) that physically flip on real Convex state change. The flip IS the product.

statusLegend.meaning: SETTLEMENT — dues paid, seat secured (green-ink status text on panel)
AUTHORITY / OWING — dues outstanding, countdown running toward eviction
EVICTION — unpaid at cycle close, seat released and waitlist promoted
PAID reported by member, awaiting inbound-email confirmation (dashed amber border)
Open seat — join with one email to claim (dashed hairline)
